title: Prior Authorization Class Schedule: Unit Basis, Approval Period and Weekly Caps
content:
Prairie Ridge Health Plan holds every Prior Authorization in one of seven classes. Each class fixes what one authorized unit is, how many calendar days an approval runs, the most units one approval may grant, the most units that may be used in one Monday-to-Sunday week, whether units unused at the end date are released and cannot be used later, and the clinical criteria used for medical necessity review.

## Schedule

| Class | One unit is | Approval period (calendar days, start date counted as day 1) | Most units per approval | Weekly frequency cap (units per Monday-Sunday week) | Units unused at end date released and not usable later | Clinical criteria |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Authorization | one study | 60 | 1 | 0 (no weekly cap) | Yes | ACR Appropriateness Criteria |
| Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | one visit | 90 | 12 | 3 | Yes | InterQual Outpatient Rehabilitation |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | one item or one rental month | 180 | 13 | 0 (no weekly cap) | Yes | InterQual DME |
| Home Health Services Authorization | one visit | 60 | 30 | 7 | Yes | InterQual Home Care |
| Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization | one program day | 30 | 20 | 5 | Yes | LOCUS/CALOCUS |
| Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization | one inpatient day | 30 | 5 | 7 | Yes | InterQual Acute Adult and Pediatric |
| Out-of-Network Services Authorization | one visit | 90 | 6 | 3 | Yes | Prairie Ridge Medical Policy MP-OON-004 |

A weekly frequency cap of 0 means the class sets no weekly cap.

## Scope of each class

| Class | Services held in the class | Servicing provider network status |
|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Authorization | MRI, CT, PET and nuclear cardiology CPT codes on the prior authorization list | in network |
| Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | PT, OT and ST treatment CPT codes after the initial evaluation | in network |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | HCPCS E, K and L codes with a purchase price above the DME threshold, or any rental | in network |
| Home Health Services Authorization | skilled nursing and home health aide visit codes, with a physician plan of care | in network |
| Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization | intensive outpatient and partial hospitalization program codes | in network |
| Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization | scheduled inpatient admissions and surgical procedures on the prior authorization list | in network |
| Out-of-Network Services Authorization | services from a provider outside the network where no in-network provider is available | out of network |

## Reading a row (hypothetical)

A hypothetical Home Health Services Authorization approval therefore counts its units in visits, runs 60 calendar days counting its start date as day 1, grants no more than 30 visits, and allows no more than 7 visits to be used in any one Monday-to-Sunday week. A hypothetical Advanced Imaging Authorization approval grants at most one study and has no weekly cap.
